quote.text:
That'll do it.
比赛结束了。

That is the win of his career.
这是他生涯最重要的一场胜利。

Yunchaokete has knocked out the 12th seed,
布云朝克特淘汰了12号种子，

and it has been emphatic today.
而且他今天赢得相当强势。
